Name: Petting Animation
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[size=5][u][b]Overview[/b][/u][/size]

This mod uses modified vanilla animations to show the player petting pets and farm animals.

By default, you can pet pets and animals as many times as you like but only the first time per day counts for friendship. You can turn off extra petting in the config.

You can change the movement and animation speeds in the config as well.


[size=5][u][b]Technical[/b][/u][/size]

Requires SMAPI.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
